title: 충청북도 청주시 설치 및 지원특례에 관한 법률 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 충청북도 청주시 설치 및 지원특례에 관한 법률
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Act is, pursuant to Article 5 (1) of the Local Autonomy Act, to establish Cheongju-si, Chungcheongbuk-do by consolidating Cheongju-si and Cheongwon-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do, thereby promoting convenience in the lives of residents and balanced regional development and faithfully implementing the agreed measures for mutually beneficial development. <Amended on January 12, 2021>
